irq_path_reconnaissance.method: vice_execution_pause -> vice_registers_get -> vice_memory_read($01) -> vice_memory_read(vector) -> vice_disassemble -> vice_execution_run, per the developer's steering

bank_state_at_check.note: HIRAM=0: KERNAL is banked OUT of $E000-$FFFF at this instant, so $FFFE/$FFFF (not KERNAL's $0314/CINV) is the live indirect IRQ dispatch the hardware actually reads. $0314-$0319 read back as the untouched power-on-adjacent pattern 01 01 01 01 01 01, confirming the game/loader never relies on the KERNAL CINV vector while KERNAL is banked out.

hardware_irq_vector.handler_disassembly: $1103: PHA / TXA / PHA / TYA / PHA / TSX / LDA $0104,X / AND #$00 / BEQ $1113 / JMP ($DE00) / $1113: JMP ($0408) / RTI -- a register-save prologue dispatching indirectly through $0408/$0409 (the $DE00 branch is currently dead: AND #$00 always clears the flag byte, so JMP ($0408) is always taken in this run).

per_frame_dispatch_target.evidence: $1574: LDX #$04 / DEX / BNE $1576 (cycle-precise delay) / LDA #$32 / STA $D018 / LDA #$16 / STA $D016 / LDA #$2C / STA $0408 / LDA #$15 / STA $0409 / LDA #$01 / STA $D01A / STA $D019 / LDA $D011 / AND #$7F / STA $D011 / LDA #$FD / STA $D012 / PLA/TAY/PLA/TAX/PLA/RTI -- a raster-split stage: sets VIC memory pointers and control register 2 for this screen band, REWRITES ITS OWN DISPATCH VECTOR ($0408/$0409) to $152C for the next raster interrupt, clears the raster-compare high bit, arms the next raster line ($D012=$FD), acks and re-enables the VIC raster IRQ, restores registers, returns. This is per-frame chained raster-split code, not a mode transition -- confirmed by disassembling the next stage.

next_stage.disassembly: $152C: LDA $48 / BEQ $1532 / DEC $48 / LDA $49 / BEQ $1542 / DEC $49 / BNE $1542 / LDA $4A / BEQ $1542 / DEC $4A / DEC $49 / LDA #$30 / STA $D018 / LDA #$18 / STA $D016 ... -- decrements the same zero-page timer bytes ($48/$49/$4A) the main-loop title dispatcher polls ($08B1: LDA $49 / ORA $4A), confirming the IRQ path and the main-loop path share state through zero page rather than being independent.

irq_path_reconnaissance.coverage_statement: The armed/reconnoitred set for danish covers BOTH halves of the program the developer's steering named: the main loop (title dispatcher $08B1 -> input scanner $139E -> CIA read $143F, reached via the stopping checkpoint at the trigger and confirmed by backtrace) and the IRQ path (hardware vector $FFFE/$FFFF -> $1103 dispatcher -> per-frame raster-split chain $1574/$152C, reached by reconnaissance). Neither path's disassembly shows disk-loader or serial-bus activity at the title screen; both are ordinary display/timing game logic.
